tasks.instructions:
Experiment E1 (tests H41): Balanced image-straddling token-range tiles, no g, scale-in-smem GEMM2 for the six tc rows. Budget: 18 B200 minutes, 90 min wall. Parent = r9-d-e1-asynca (the default tc path in r9-merge); r9-d-e2-pair-smemg is in your lineage too (reuse its 'one producer warp owns a whole stage, stages round-robin over warps' signalling). Keep every sc row and the sc_kernel untouched; keep the old tc path in the file so that any tc row where the new path loses stays on the r9 code (per-row dispatch by shape).

STEP 0 (<= 2 B200 min, answers the premise audit): (a) read tc_kernel's flat self-resetting barrier: the arriving side must be __syncthreads then one thread red.release.gpu (or __threadfence + atomicAdd); the waiting side must spin with ld.acquire.gpu, then execute fence.proxy.async (so the CTA's later TMA reads of d/h/scratch written by other CTAs' generic stores are ordered), then __syncthreads. Add whatever is missing. (b) cuobjdump -res-usage on the shipped parent build: STACK must be 0 for tc_kernel and sc_kernel; record registers. (c) 1500-call stress loop at 8,768 and 16,384 against the fp32 torch reference (max |err| must stay <= the r8 log + 1e-4 on every call). If (a)-(c) show anything, revert tc_kernel to cg grid.sync and report; otherwise record 'barrier verified'.

STEP 1: flat token layouts. d scratch becomes [C][B*HW] fp16 and h becomes [4C][B*HW] fp16 with no per-image padding (the conv unit's stores and the TMA maps change; token = b*HW + hw). TMA box starts along the token axis must be multiples of 8 tokens (16 B).

STEP 2: tile tables per tc row (host, shape-only): GEMM1 tiles = hidden tiles x token ranges, ranges = ceil(ceil(B*HW / R) / 8) * 8 tokens with (hidden tiles x R) <= 148: 16,384 12 x 12 (264 tokens, N = 272 as two MMAs 128 + 144 into adjacent TMEM columns); 32,768 24 x 6 (264); 16,768 24 x 6 (136, N = 144); 8,768 24 x 6 (72, N = 80); 8,384 12 x 12 (136, N = 144); 2,768 only if time remains (24 x 5 ranges of 24 tokens, N = 32), otherwise it stays on the parent path (24.0 us). Epilogue per tile: LN fold + A&S GELU as now; the sumsq per (image, k) is accumulated in registers per image segment (image = token / HW, at most 2 segments at 14x14 and 6-7 at 7x7 per 264-token range; the 4-way image select exists) and red.add-ed into gsum[B][4C] (fp32, zeroed in phase A before sync 1); h stores only (no g, no gf in the epilogue). GEMM2 units = out-channel tiles x token ranges x KS with the same balancing (<= 148 units per pass, or 2 per CTA where unavoidable).

STEP 3: GEMM2 with one accumulator (N = range, two MMAs when > 256). After sync 2 each CTA computes, for the <= 7 images its units touch, gf[k] = sqrt(gsum[b][k]) and mean_k gf (one block reduction per image over 4C values), then s[b][k] = 1 + gw[k] * gf[k] / (mean + eps) for its K slices into smem (<= 7 x 768 fp32). Ring: A 16 KB + B (64 k x N x 2 B) per 64-k stage, as many stages as fit (>= 4). The stage-owner producer warp (round-robin over 4 producer warps, >= 2 stages ahead of the MMA warp) waits for the stage's TMA landing, multiplies the B tile in place by s[img(token)][k] (each k row is 128 contiguous bytes per 64-token chunk in the SW128 layout; 16-B vectors of 8 tokens can straddle an image boundary at HW = 49 or 196, so select per element), then fence.proxy.async.shared::cta and arrives on the ready barrier. Epilogue: out[b][c][hw] via the existing per-token addressing (red.add for KS > 1 into the x + b2' prefill).

STEP 4: run_tests 16/16 (portal-order re-runs); interleave x3 in one container vs r9-merge on the six tc rows; globaltimer stamps of GEMM1 end (median / max) at 16,384 and GEMM2 per-stage time at 8,768; cuobjdump STACK 0; PRECISION LOG over 10 seeded rounds (fp64 reference, harness generators) for every tc row the new path ships (the hidden is now rounded twice). If any row has a beyond-atol element, switch that row's B operand to the hi/lo fp16 split and re-log. Ship the new path only on rows where it wins; report per-row rented times and the stamps.

Optional if >= 3 B200 min remain: createpolicy evict_first on the W1/W2 fp32 loads in phase A, interleaved x3 at 8,768 / 32,768 (ship if >= 0.7 us). Success: In-container vs r9-merge: 16,384 <= 44 us and at least one of 32,768 <= 56, 8,384 <= 30.5, 16,768 <= 39.5, 8,768 <= 30; GEMM1 end (max over CTAs) at 16,384 >= 4 us earlier than the parent's; run_tests 16/16; precision log 0 beyond own atol on every shipped row. Refuted if: At 16,384 the GEMM1 end (max over CTAs) is less than 2 us earlier than the parent's despite one tile per CTA, or the in-place B scale makes GEMM2 stages > 1.3x the parent's stage time at 8,768 with >= 2 stages of look-ahead, or the new path wins no tc row by >= 1.5 us in-container. This is an EXPLORATION task: the goal is to learn whether this idea can move some size band by 3% or more on the portal, not to edge out the current best by 0.1%. You may discard the parent's design entirely; it is given for reference. Test the idea's core assumption with probe_b200 first (seconds per probe). If the idea does not pan out, still return your best version of it as the candidate and record what you learned in the card's findings: negative results are valuable and go into the lab notebook for later rounds. CUDA C++ uses the two-file layout. Set the card's tests: field to the hypothesis id(s). OPERATOR NOTE (rules): every red.add / atomic target is zeroed or prefilled inside this call before its first add (the workspace is torch.empty, uninitialised); grid-barrier counters live in a module-level __device__ buffer self-reset by the last arriver, never in the workspace; spins are plain ld.acquire loops. No PDL; stamps compiled out of the shipped build; target_hardware [B200] only; TMA descriptors encoded every call; cuBLASLt (if any) caches only the per-shape heuristic. No converted weights or other state kept between calls.

Experiment E2 (tests H42): Custom tcgen05 GEMM2 launch replaces K3 + cuBLASLt G2 at 8,320 and 4,96 (4 launches -> 3). Budget: 18 B200 minutes, 90 min wall. Keep g_tc (pass 1), K0 and the 64,96 / 32,128 path (g_pass1 + K3 + cuBLASLt G2) unchanged; the new kernel is dispatched for 8,320 and 4,96 only.

STEP 0 (host/K0, no probe): K0 additionally writes fp16 W2 as [C][4C] row-major (K-major for the swap-AB A operand; TMA SW128 boxes of 128 rows x 64 k) and b2'[c] = sum_k W2[c][k] * gb[k] + b2[c] in fp32 (320 dot products of length 1280; one warp per c). Keep K0 at its current 3.5-4.5 us (check with harness_time).

STEP 1: g_g2 kernel, 1SM tcgen05 kind::f16, swap-AB, using your validated recipe (idesc, K-major SW128 A box SBO 1024 +32 B per k16, MN-major B 64-token chunks LBO = 64 k x 128 B, SBO 1024, +2048 per k16, tcgen05.ld 32x32b). Units = (c-tile, image, token chunk): 8,320 c-tiles 128 / 128 / 64 (the last via M=64 or a masked 128-row tile with TMA zero fill), 8 images x 4 chunks of 256 tokens = 96 units, N = 256 (one MMA per k16, 256 TMEM columns); 4,96 one c-tile of 96 rows (masked), chunks of 224 tokens (56 units) or 112 (112 units): time both. B = the pass-1 h_b array [K2 = 4C + 8][HW] per image (ignore the 8 augmentation rows: K = 4C exactly). Prologue per CTA: load gsum[b][0..4C) (the red.add sums pass 1 already writes), gf = sqrt, block-reduce mean_k, s[k] = 1 + gw[k] * gf[k] / (mean + eps) into smem (4C fp32), plus b2' for the c-tile. Ring: 4-6 stages of A 16 KB + B 32 KB (N = 256). Four producer warps, each owning a whole stage round-robin (>= 2 stages ahead of the MMA warp): wait for the TMA landing, scale the B tile in place by s[k] (each k row is 128 contiguous bytes per 64-token chunk; cvt to f32, multiply, cvt back, 16-B vectors), fence.proxy.async.shared::cta, arrive. One MMA warp with elect.sync, commit to the accumulator barrier. Stamp (globaltimer + clock64, from the MMA warp) the clk per 128x256x16 instruction at 8,320 and report it (audit item: does 1SM reach the ~256 clk ideal at N = 256 with TMA-fed operands?). Epilogue on all non-producer warps: tcgen05.ld, out[b][c][hw] = x[b][c][hw] + acc + b2'[c]; stage each 128-row x 256-token tile through the (now free) ring smem so that global reads of x and stores of out are 128-B-coalesced along hw (NCHW rows are contiguous for HW = 1024 / 3136).

STEP 2: validate g_g2 standalone against torch (fp32 reference of x + W2 (h * s) + b2') at both rows; then harness_time of the 3-launch pipeline vs the 4-launch parent interleaved x3 in one container at 8,320 and 4,96, plus g_g2 standalone cold (after the 2xL2 flush).

STEP 3: run_tests 16/16 (portal-order re-runs; the other 12 rows run the r0 anchor as a merge-only candidate), cuobjdump STACK 0 and <= 128 regs, PRECISION LOG over 10 seeded rounds (fp64 reference, harness generators) at 8,320 (atol 2.4e-3, the tightest row) and 4,96: the hidden is now rounded twice (fp16 h then fp16(h * s)). If any element is beyond atol + 1e-5|ref|, switch to the hi/lo B split (B_hi = fp16(h*s), B_lo = fp16(h*s - B_hi), two MMAs per k16) or scale the A tile per unit from fp32 W2 instead, re-log, and report the cost.

Stretch if >= 5 B200 min remain: dispatch g_g2 at 32,128 too (32 images x 16 chunks, persistent over 512 units) and compare with K3 + cuBLASLt (7.5 + 48.4 us); ship there only if faster in-container. Success: g_g2 standalone cold <= 9 us at 8,320 and <= 4.5 us at 4,96; rows in-container vs the parent 8,320 <= 49 us and 4,96 <= 31 us rented; run_tests 16/16; precision log 0 beyond own atol at both rows. Refuted if: g_g2 standalone cold > 14 us at 8,320 after the ring and epilogue are tuned (no better than K3 + cuBLASLt minus a launch), or the in-place B scale holds stages > 1.5x the N=256 MMA ideal with 2 stages of look-ahead, or the twice-rounded hidden fails the 10-round log at 8,320 and both fallbacks cost more than the K3 + G2 pair they replace. This is an EXPLORATION task: the goal is to learn whether this idea can move some size band by 3% or more on the portal, not to edge out the current best by 0.1%. You may discard the parent's design entirely; it is given for reference. Test the idea's core assumption with probe_b200 first (seconds per probe). If the idea does not pan out, still return your best version of it as the candidate and record what you learned in the card's findings: negative results are valuable and go into the lab notebook for later rounds. Experiment E3 (tests H43): New design: top-row pass 1 at the pipe bounds (bulk-staged register-blocked conv on FMA, tcgen05 GEMM1, GELU epilogue warps) for 64,96 and 32,128. Budget: 18 B200 minutes, 90 min wall. You start a new lineage (I) and may read only the r0 baseline, the lab notebook and the lineage conclusions; the notebook holds everything you need: the tcgen05 recipe (H r8: idesc = (1<<4)|(1<<16)|(N>>3)<<17|(128>>4)<<24, K-major SW128 A box SBO 1024 +32 B per k16, MN-major B [channel][token] 64-token chunks LBO = C*128, SBO 1024, +2048 per k16, tcgen05.ld 32x32b.x32), G r9's writer address functions for d written by plain st.shared into the SW128 B layout (A image byte = r*128 + (((c>>3) ^ (r&7))<<4) + (c&7)*2; B byte = (t>>6)*LBO + c*128 + ((((t&63)>>3) ^ (c&7))<<4) + (t&7)*2), the GRN tail (red.add per tile into a [B][4C] gsum zeroed by K0; a GRN-scale launch building per-image fp16 W2_b = fp16(W2 * s_b) and b2' hi/lo columns, grid (B, C/16), one row per warp, __launch_bounds__(512,2); cuBLASLt batched swap-AB GEMM2: A = h_b [K2 = 4C + 8][HW] fp16 per image with two constant 1,1 rows, B = W2_b [C][K2], C = x_b, D = out, beta 1, writes NCHW; ~6.6 TB/s at these rows), and the precision rules (d16, fp16(lnw*W1), h16 once, A&S erfc GELU; log 10 seeded rounds vs fp64). Target rows: 64,96,112,112 and 32,128,64,64 only; every other row runs the r0 anchor (merge-only candidate).

GATE (STEP 1, <= 5 B200 min): conv-only kernel at 64,96. Persistent CTAs of 16 warps, 1 CTA/SM, tile = R=2 image rows x W tokens x all C channels (224 tokens at 64,96; use R=3, 192 tokens at 32,128); each CTA takes a contiguous run of strips so halo rows hit L2. One TMA warp streams x in channel groups: for each group of 12 (64,96) or 16 (32,128) channels, (R+6) rows x W x 4 B per channel by 1-D cp.async.bulk (3.6 KB per channel at W=112) into a 2-stage ring (~43 KB per stage) with mbarrier expect_tx; zero rows at the image top/bottom are handled by predication, left/right zero padding by the tap loop. Eight conv warps compute register-blocked 2x8 output patches per lane (49 taps per channel in registers via __ldg from a K0-padded [C][7][8] buffer, inputs from LDS, ~7 FMA per LDS) and write fp16 d straight into the MN-major SW128 B tile (double-buffered, 43 KB each) plus per-token sum / sumsq partials in smem (fp32 of the fp16-rounded d). Measure with globaltimer and harness_time after the 2xL2 flush: conv-only pass over the whole 64,96 tensor (writing d tiles but no MMA / epilogue). Bound: 102 us at 1.95 GHz. Report rented us and the clock.

STEP 2 (only if STEP 1 <= 250 us; otherwise spend the remaining time on diagnosing the conv and report): add the GEMM: K0 writes W1' = fp16(lnw * W1) [4C][C] and u/v fold vectors; one MMA warp issues kind::f16 128 x N x 16 against A = W1' boxes 128 hidden x 64 k (K=96: 64 + 32) streamed per tile by TMA into a 2 x 16 KB ring (per-SM ingest ~74 KB per tile, negligible), 3 hidden blocks (4 at C=128) into two 224-column TMEM slots ping-ponged (slot reuse as G did). Six epilogue warps per finished block: tcgen05.ld, LN fold z = rs*(acc - mu*u) + v, A&S erfc GELU (do NOT add an FMA-polynomial erf: the FMA pipe is the binding one here), per-(image,k) sumsq partials red.add-ed into gsum, fp16 h stores staged through a per-warp 2 KB smem transpose so each STG.128 writes 64 B rows (h_b layout [K2][HW] per image with the two constant rows). Validate pass 1 against a torch reference of the hidden (fp16 tolerance) on a small shape before timing.

STEP 3: the tail (GRN-scale launch + cuBLASLt batched swap-AB GEMM2 exactly as in the notebook recipe), run_tests 16/16 (portal-order re-runs), cuobjdump STACK 0 at <= 128 regs x 512 threads, in-container interleaved x3 vs r9-merge at 64,96 and 32,128, PRECISION LOG over 10 seeded rounds at both rows. Report per-phase stamps (conv-only, pass 1, K3, G2) whatever the outcome: the top-row story needs the numbers even if nothing ships. Success: Conv-only <= 180 us and pass 1 <= 350 us rented at 64,96; rows in-container vs r9-merge 64,96 <= 560 us and 32,128 <= 150 us; run_tests 16/16; precision log 0 beyond own atol on both rows. Refuted if: The conv-only build with bulk-staged row bands and register-blocked patches is > 300 us rented at 64,96 (3x the FMA bound, no better than G's 472 by a margin that pays), or pass 1 with the MMA and GELU warps is > 550 us (the warp roles do not overlap on one SM), in which case the fused top-row family is closed and the remaining top-row lever is the tensor-core Toeplitz conv (I15).
